pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit soft pixel gradients at the edges with low angularity. Patch size is heterogeneous, with larger, sub-ovoid shapes on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more irregular, and more closely packed polygons on the lower hindquarter and thigh.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light pelage with variable pixel thickness. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent. The pathways are most continuous and demonstrate increased pixel thickness in the ventral and posterior regions of the visible flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized cluster of small, dark, punctate markings visible in the perineal area immediately below the tail base.
